product_overview: A web-based personal and family financial manager for tracking transactions, budgets, recurring expenses, net worth and importing bank data. Built with Next.js and Supabase, it provides dashboards, transaction management and reconciliation tools to monitor financial health.
core_goals: Centralize incomes, expenses and net worth into a single web interface
Provide actionable financial KPIs and projections (50/30/20, autonomy, end-of-month projection)
Enable manual and bulk (CSV) transaction intake with reconciliation
Support budgets, recurring expenses and consolidated family views
Secure user authentication and per-user data isolation via Supabase

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Secure login and signup using Supabase Auth to gate access to the app and user-specific data.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill email input -> Fill password input -> Click Login button -> Redirect to / -> See total balance
Navigate to /login -> Fill email input -> Fill password input -> Click Signup button -> See email verification prompt
Navigate to /login -> Fill invalid email input -> Fill password input -> Click Login button -> See authentication error message

features.name: Dashboard Overview
features.description: Authenticated landing page showing total balance, income/expense breakdown, recent transactions and core KPIs to assess financial health.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> See total balance -> View income/expense breakdown -> View recent transactions list
Navigate to / -> See redirect to /login when not authenticated -> Navigate to /login -> Fill email input -> Fill password input -> Click Login button -> Redirect to /
Navigate to / -> See KPI card for autonomy calculation -> Click KPI card for details -> See autonomy detail modal

features.name: Transaction Management
features.description: Create, view, filter and delete financial transactions (income and expenses) with a dialog-driven form.
user_flows: Navigate to /transacoes -> Click Open "Nova Transação" dialog -> Fill transaction details (description, value, category, date) -> Select transaction type (Income/Expense) -> Click Submit form -> See transaction in list

Navigate to /transacoes -> Click Open "Nova Transação" dialog -> Leave required field empty -> Click Submit form -> See validation error message -> Fill missing required field -> Click Submit form -> See transaction in list
Navigate to /transacoes -> Locate transaction row -> Click Delete transaction from list -> Confirm deletion -> See transaction removed from list
Navigate to /transacoes -> Attempt to delete transaction -> See deletion error message (network/backend) -> Retry deletion -> See transaction removed

features.name: Recurring Expenses
features.description: Manage monthly fixed or recurring bills: add, toggle active status and remove recurring entries.
user_flows: Navigate to /recorrentes -> Click Add new recurring expense -> Fill recurring expense details -> Click Save -> See new recurring expense in list
Navigate to /recorrentes -> Click Add new recurring expense -> Enter invalid amount -> Click Save -> See validation error message -> Correct amount -> Click Save -> See new recurring expense in list
Navigate to /recorrentes -> Locate recurring expense -> Click Toggle active status -> See recurring expense status update
Navigate to /recorrentes -> Locate recurring expense -> Click Delete recurring expense -> Confirm deletion -> See recurring expense removed

features.name: Budget Tracking
features.description: Set monthly budget limits per category and monitor progress with visual progress bars and alerts when thresholds are reached.
user_flows: Navigate to /orcamentos -> Click Add new budget limit -> Fill category field -> Fill amount field -> Click Save -> See budget listed with progress bar
Navigate to /orcamentos -> Click Add new budget limit -> Leave amount empty -> Click Save -> See validation error message -> Fill amount -> Click Save -> See budget listed
Navigate to /orcamentos -> View budget progress bar -> See alert when spending reaches 80% of limit -> Click budget to view details -> See spending breakdown
Navigate to /orcamentos -> Locate budget item -> Click Delete budget -> Confirm deletion -> See budget removed

features.name: Net Worth Tracking
features.description: Record assets and liabilities, view total net worth calculation and manage individual items affecting net worth.
user_flows: Navigate to /patrimonio -> Click Add new asset or liability -> Fill item details (type, value, description) -> Click Save -> See item listed and net worth recalculated
Navigate to /patrimonio -> Click Add new asset or liability -> Enter non-numeric value in value field -> Click Save -> See validation error message -> Correct value -> Click Save -> See item listed
Navigate to /patrimonio -> Locate item in list -> Click Delete item -> Confirm deletion -> See item removed and net worth updated

features.name: Bank Reconciliation (CSV Import)
features.description: Import bank or card transactions via CSV, map columns, review parsed rows and confirm import into transactions.
user_flows: Navigate to /conciliacao -> Click Upload CSV file -> Select CSV file -> Map columns (Date, Description, Value) -> Click Review parsed data -> Click Confirm import -> See imported transactions in /transacoes list

Navigate to /conciliacao -> Click Upload CSV file -> Select file with invalid format -> See import error message -> Replace file with valid CSV -> Retry upload -> Map columns -> Confirm import -> See imported transactions

Navigate to /conciliacao -> Upload CSV file -> Map columns incorrectly -> Click Review parsed data -> See mapping validation error -> Correct mappings -> Click Review parsed data -> Click Confirm import -> See imported transactions
